name: Fardir's Folly
summary: Fardir's Folly is an Ayleid ruin in northeastern Reaper's March, north of Fort Sphinxmoth containing Colovian raiders. They are led by Ravo Peltrasius. There are more than a dozen bookshelves in the ruin and an Ayleid Well. Centipedes are found in numbers within.
notes: The northernmost part of the ruins, which is just outside of the zone boundaries, was probably originally supposed to represent the ruin of Silorn (note the distinct cross-shaped layout of the ruin). However, Silorn later made a proper appearance in the West Weald zone.
